## Intent

Describe the user-visible or architecture outcome.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] Desktop mouse/orbit path checked
- [ ] Mobile responsive layout checked
- [ ] WebXR path checked when XR code changes
- [ ] Performance impact documented when materials, post-processing or media paths change

## Scene/data changes

- [ ] Manifest schema remains backward-compatible, or schema version was incremented
- [ ] Geometry accuracy is marked `illustrative` or `surveyed`
- [ ] New media sources have a fallback and cleanup path

## Risk

List device-specific limitations, browser fallbacks and rollback steps.
